Return the Salesforce authorization URL for the front-end to redirect to.

Called server-side by the authenticated front-end so the signed
``state`` can be bound to the caller's organization.

Returns:
    The authorization URL for the front-end to redirect the user to.

Salesforce redirects the browser here, then we bounce back to the app.

On denied consent Salesforce redirects with ``error`` and no ``code``,
so both are optional and the error path is handled explicitly.

Returns:
    A redirect back to the app with the success or error outcome.
